DataFusion previously computed this exact division as DECIMAL with six fractional digits; the runtime now computes DOUBLE PRECISION. Both agree with the DuckDB reference within the comparison tolerance; the candidate keeps the digits beyond the sixth that the baseline rounded away. The entry is optional because it can only fire while the baseline commit predates the runtime that changed the division, so it is not stale once a baseline carries that runtime. Output precision change, not a row difference.

differences.match: Physical plan does not support logical expression Exists(
differences.justification: DataFusion 54.0.0 cannot plan a correlated EXISTS subquery in these TPC-H Havoc variants and fails with `This feature is not implemented: Physical plan does not support logical expression Exists(`. Engine limit on correlated subqueries, not a translation difference; a DataFusion upgrade that supports them makes the entry stale and fails the gate until it is removed.
